user_goal.text: Befriend on Venmo everyone the user sent money to or received money from during the specified month.
user_goal.rationale: This restates the official user instruction.

benchmark_success.rationale: TestTracker success requires every registered test block to pass.

checked_by.text: The official AppWorld evaluator uses TestTracker to score four registered checks covering the submitted answer and the venmo.Friendship database changes.
checked_by.rationale: Only the four with-test contexts register native scoring outcomes; the task-status assignment does not.

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained submitted answer and official evaluator comparison result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evaluator result show that the registered answer-comparison test passed?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained start/end database diff and official evaluator registered-test results
decisive_artifacts.question: Do the retained results show that only venmo.Friendship changed, the added friend IDs matched the official expected set ignoring order, and no friendships were removed?

success_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert answers match.
success_if.rationale: The retained submitted answer must pass the evaluator's official answer comparison.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_002_ca2e15a2c5ac] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert model changes match venmo.Friendship
success_if.rationale: The retained database diff must show venmo.Friendship as the exact changed-model set.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_003_155c03a7c469] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: obtain all new records in venmo.Friendship (obtained via models.changed_records), and thereby obtain all user_ids of main_user's new friends, then, assert these new_friend_ids match exactly to private_data.to_befriend_user_ids (ignore order)
success_if.rationale: The added Friendship records must yield exactly the officially specified friend-ID set, ignoring order.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_004_7a3e1bd0ff66] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert no friendships have been removed from venmo.Friendship (obtained above via models.changed_records).
success_if.rationale: The retained database diff must contain zero removed Friendship records.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert answers match.
fail_if.rationale: A failed official answer comparison is a registered-test failure.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_002_ca2e15a2c5ac] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert model changes match venmo.Friendship
fail_if.rationale: Any changed-model set other than exactly venmo.Friendship fails this registered test.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_003_155c03a7c469] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: obtain all new records in venmo.Friendship (obtained via models.changed_records), and thereby obtain all user_ids of main_user's new friends, then, assert these new_friend_ids match exactly to private_data.to_befriend_user_ids (ignore order)
fail_if.rationale: A missing, extra, or mismatched added friend ID fails the exact-set comparison.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_004_7a3e1bd0ff66] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert no friendships have been removed from venmo.Friendship (obtained above via models.changed_records).
fail_if.rationale: Any removed Friendship record fails this registered test.

undecided_if.text: Undecided only if retained evidence cannot determine one or more frozen registered-test outcomes.
undecided_if.rationale: A registered-test outcome must not be inferred when its decisive retained evidence is missing or non-decisive.
